    StartersKingston stamp and go saltfish frittersCrisp Jamaican salt cod fritters with spring onion, chilli and thyme, with limeHow to make it250g salt cod150g plain flour1 tsp baking powder180ml water3 spring onions, sliced1 small red chilli, finely chopped1 tsp thyme leaves1 garlic clove, crushed1 tomato, finely diced1/4 tsp black pepper750ml vegetable oil, for frying1 lime, cut into wedgesSoak the salt cod in cold water in the fridge overnight, changing the water twice.Simmer the cod in fresh water for 15 minutes, drain, then flake it, picking out any skin and bones.Whisk the flour, baking powder and water into a thick batter.Stir in the cod, spring onions, chilli, thyme, garlic, tomato and pepper.Heat the oil to 180°C in a deep heavy pan.Fry heaped spoonfuls in batches for 3 minutes, turning, until puffed and golden. Drain on paper towel.Serve hot with the lime wedges.Crab Key plantain chipsThin green plantain chips fried crisp, tossed with lime zest, chilli and sea saltHow to make it3 green plantains or green cooking bananas750ml vegetable oil, for frying1 tsp sea salt flakes1/2 tsp chilli powder1 limeCut the ends off the plantains, score the skin along the ridges and prise it off.Slice the plantains 2mm thick on a mandoline.Heat the oil to 175°C in a deep heavy pan.Fry in batches for about 3 minutes until crisp and pale gold, then drain on paper towel.Toss with the salt, chilli powder and the zest and a squeeze of the lime.Escovitch fish with fried bammyUnderneath the mango tree, Honey's song.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsQuarrel's jerk chicken with rice and peasChicken thighs marinated in scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme, roasted and charred, with coconut rice and kidney beansHow to make it1.2kg chicken thighs, bone in, skin on6 spring onions1 habanero chilli, seeded5 garlic cloves1 tbsp ginger, grated4 tsp ground allspice3 tsp thyme leaves1/2 tsp ground cinnamon1/2 tsp ground nutmeg2 tbsp brown sugar3 tbsp soy sauce2 limes2 tbsp vegetable oil1 tsp black pepper1 1/2 tsp salt300g long grain rice, rinsed400g tin red kidney beans, drained400ml tin coconut milk200ml waterBlitz 4 of the spring onions, the chilli, 4 garlic cloves, the ginger, 3 tsp of the allspice, 2 tsp of the thyme, the cinnamon, nutmeg, sugar, soy sauce, juice of 1 lime, oil, pepper and 1 tsp of the salt to a paste.Slash the chicken to the bone, rub all over with the marinade and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the chicken on a rack for 40 minutes, then char on a hot barbecue or under the grill for 5 minutes.For the rice and peas, bring the coconut milk, water, the last 2 spring onions bashed whole, the last garlic clove crushed, the remaining allspice, thyme and salt to a simmer. Add the rice and beans, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then stand for 5.Rest the chicken for 5 minutes and serve with the rice and peas and the second lime in wedges.SweetsHoney Ryder's coconut totoSpiced coconut and brown sugar cake with a crunchy coconut top and lime whipped creamHow to make it250g plain flour2 tsp baking powder1 tsp ground cinnamon1/2 tsp ground nutmeg1/4 tsp salt150g brown sugar100g desiccated coconut1 egg250ml coconut milk80g butter, melted, plus extra for the tin1 tsp vanilla extract2 tbsp demerara sugar2 tbsp shredded coconut200ml thickened cream1 lime, zestedHeat the oven to 180°C and butter a 20cm square tin.Mix the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, brown sugar and desiccated coconut.Whisk the egg, coconut milk, melted butter and vanilla and stir into the dry mix.Spread into the tin and scatter with the demerara and shredded coconut.Bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.Cool in the tin for 20 minutes.Whip the cream with the lime zest to soft peaks and serve with the toto cut into squares.DrinksPuss-Feller's planter's punchDark rum, fresh lime, sugar syrup and pineapple over ice with bitters and grated nutmegHow to make it60ml lime juice, freshly squeezed120ml sugar syrup180ml dark rum240ml pineapple juicearomatic bitters, 4 dashes3 cups icewhole nutmeg, for grating1 lime, sliced into wheelsStir the lime juice, sugar syrup, rum, pineapple juice and bitters together in a jug.Chill for 30 minutes.Pour over ice in 4 glasses, grate over a little nutmeg and add a lime wheel.Ice cold Red Stripe lagerBond's cold one, once the scuffle is over.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
